I am old now, 72 years, and my back does not bend like before. My son is in town working, only my wife and I are here. So I plan carefully — cannot do too much heavy work.

I have 9 mu. I will do it like last year, that worked fine. 3 mu I keep in cotton — I have grown cotton my whole life, I know it. The other 6 mu is my wheat and maize land, same ground, two crops in one year. That is how we do it here in Quzhou.

**Wheat (6 mu):** I plant in October after maize comes off. The seed shop sells good improved wheat, Jimai type, neighbors all use it. Before ploughing I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that is 50 kg of the 15-15-15 kind. Then at green-up in spring I topdress urea, about half a bag per mu (20 kg). I water the winter water, then green-up water, then the grain-filling water — three times. I spray twice, once for weeds in spring, once for aphids before harvest. Last year I got about 500 kg per mu. Should be the same.

**Maize (6 mu):** Right after wheat harvest in June I plant maize directly into the stubble — no ploughing, saves money and time. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or what the dealer has. At planting I put compound fertilizer 40 kg per mu down with the seed. When stalks are tall, big-bell stage, I topdress urea half a bag per mu (25 kg). Two waters is enough if rain comes. Spray once for armyworm, maybe twice if it is bad. Get about 550 kg per mu.

**Cotton (3 mu):** Cotton is troublesome but I know it. Plant late April. Bt seed — used to be we sprayed many times for bollworm, now Bt seed is better. Before planting I plough and put one bag compound per mu. At flowering I add urea 15 kg per mu. Cotton still needs spraying for aphids, spider mites, sometimes bollworm — four or five times. Water three times. About 250 kg seed cotton per mu.

I do not want to waste fertilizer money, but too little and the yield drops — that is worse. Better one bag extra than a bad crop.
